page.layout: One printed page: one text block, full width, with the catchword at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: explicare videatur. Quod reliquum est, Deum immortalem precor, ut ad nomi-nis sui gloriam, & Reipub. atq; Ecclesię utilitatem, vos diu incolumes conser-vet, & donis suis spiritualibus quotidie magis magisq; ornet atque locupletet. Bene in Christo Iesu valeant Domini, & E. V. quibus me meosq; reverenter commendo. Tubingae ex musaeo nostro, anno M.D.LXXXIIII.

page.notes: The text ends mid-sentence with "AN-", the catchword for the next page. Faint show-through from the reverse side is in the lower half and was left out. A faint mark at the foot centre (possibly a gathering signature) is too unclear to read, so it is omitted. The long s in "musaeo" is printed with a form that resembles f; it is transcribed as s per the rule. The printed "Kalend.Ianuarij." is treated as its own line.
